about.title: Hi, we're Tide & Tea
about.body:
Tide & Tea Nails is a Chennai nail studio that comes to you. Every set starts with your inspo and a look at your natural nails, so we can suggest the extension that will last best on you.

We sterilise our metal tools between every client and use a fresh file and buffer for each set.

*Edit this story in the owner app under Website, then About us.*

faq.q: How long do gel nail extensions last?
faq.a: Soft gel and acrylic sets usually last 3 to 4 weeks, depending on your nail growth and how you use your hands. We recommend a refill or a fresh set after that.

faq.q: Do you come to my home?
faq.a: Yes. We do home visits across Chennai and Chengalpattu, every day from 10:00 am to 8:00 pm. Travel charges apply for home visits; please contact us to confirm the travel charge for your area. You can also choose to come to the studio.

faq.q: Which extension is best for my nails?
faq.a: Upload a photo of your natural nails when you book. We look at it with your inspo and suggest the extension that will hold up best on you.

Each set comes in sizes, or made to your measurements for custom sets. Use the sizing guide on the shop page, or send us a photo and we'll size it for you. Every order comes with glue tabs, liquid nail glue, a cuticle pusher, a nail buffer and alcohol wipes.

For appointments, pay a small advance by UPI right after you book to hold your slot. If we can't do your set, we refund it in full. The balance is paid on the day. Press-on orders are paid online at checkout.

sizing:
Measure the widest part of each nail with a soft tape, or press clear tape across the nail, mark the edges and measure it on a ruler.

- **S**: thumb 15 mm, index 11 mm, middle 12 mm, ring 11 mm, little 8 mm
- **M**: thumb 16 mm, index 12 mm, middle 13 mm, ring 12 mm, little 9 mm
- **L**: thumb 17 mm, index 13 mm, middle 14 mm, ring 13 mm, little 10 mm

Between sizes? Pick the larger one and file the sides to fit. For a custom set, add your ten measurements in the order notes.

policies.shipping: Ready press-on sets ship within 2 to 4 working days. Made-to-order sets ship within 5 to 7 working days. Delivery across India usually takes 3 to 6 days after dispatch. You will get a tracking link when your order ships.
policies.returns: Press-ons are made to fit and can't be returned once opened, for hygiene reasons. If your order arrives damaged or wrong, message us within 48 hours with photos and an unboxing video and we will replace it or refund you.
policies.cancellation:
Press-on orders can be cancelled for a full refund until they are shipped. Refunds go back to your original payment method within 5 to 7 working days.

For appointments, your advance is refundable if you cancel at least 24 hours before your slot. Later cancellations or no-shows forfeit the advance. We are happy to move your slot once at no charge.
policies.privacy: We collect your name, phone number, address and the photos you upload only to provide your appointment or deliver your order. If you tap “Use my current location” when booking a home visit, your location is used only to find your address for that booking and to show it to us; it is not used for anything else. Payments are handled by our payment partner; we never see or store your card details. We do not sell or share your details with anyone else. To have your data deleted, contact us.
policies.terms: Prices are in Indian rupees. Appointment prices are confirmed when we approve your request. Offers and coupon codes can't be combined unless stated, and may end without notice. By booking or ordering you agree to these terms and our policies.
